title: kube.workload.restart input
description: Restarts one pod Job (a finite job or a long-lived service) addressed by run id by recreating it from its admitted published container profile. The caller supplies the exact opaque resourceVersion observed at admission (via kube.workload.summarize or kube.snapshot.read); it is the compare-and-swap and is never re-fetched or interpreted by the runtime. Operation id, idempotency digest, and worker identity are resolved by the trusted runtime; the target node is decided by trusted placement unless targetNode rehomes the pod: then that node must be inside the deployment placement authority and satisfy the pod's declared placement, and node-bound state is carried there. approvalId is a model-supplied selector naming the exact approval on the phase-two dispatch — never itself authority: the kernel consumes that exact approval server-side.

approvalId.description: Model-supplied selector naming the exact kernel approval on the phase-two dispatch — never itself authority: the kernel consumes that exact approval server-side.

expectedResourceVersion.description: Opaque Kubernetes resourceVersion of the addressed Job as observed at admission.

targetNode.description: Rehome: the cluster node (e.g. pc, mini) to restart the pod on. The pod's declared placement must hold there; its per-pod state is checkpointed and carried. Omit for a plain restart.
